Repaint image 1 into the same exact 1254 x 1254 stone pavement crop. This is a STRONG MATERIAL REPLACEMENT, not a detail-preserving filter. Replace every slab face completely.
The desired material is the smooth blue-grey natural flagstone in the foreground of IMAGE 3. Each big slab has a quiet solid stone face, broad subtle nonperiodic cloudy variation, a few tiny naturally random pores and sparse soft irregular veins. Paint opaque fresh stone surface over ALL the hundreds of little checker cells currently on image 1. The interiors must no longer contain ANY visible tiny squares, tiny diamonds, tiny cobbles, mosaic, fishscales, cellular pattern, mesh, repeated tessellation, repeated dots or crosshatching. Do not preserve them faintly. No decorative pattern at all.
Use image 1 ONLY to locate the big slab outlines and their dark main joints: keep the same camera and the same large stone sizes, count, edges, corner nodes and grout exit coordinates. Keep those thick coarse diagonal grout lines connected and at exactly the same positions. Everything inside those big boundaries is to be repainted from scratch as plain natural blue-grey flagstone matching image 3. The lower region follows the same rule. No objects. No letters. No grass. No global composition changes.
Use restrained warm daylight, smooth mineral faces, crisp slab edges, low contrast within stone. No sharp golden glowing outline, no bloom, no blur, no sharpened raster noise. The output must clearly look simpler and more naturally stone-like than the original dense artificial mosaic. Return opaque1254-square, no crop, no padding, no border.
